R0.definition: incumbent's archived recommendations: data/edgelab/recommendations source=pipeline_recommendations status in RECOMMENDED/BET_PLACED/RECOMMENDED_NOT_BET; side YES except NRFI=NO on KXMLBRFI; model = archived modelFairProbability (selection side)
R0.entry: latest observed two-sided quote at or before min(recommendation provenance.capturedAt, first_pitch-10min); recommendation must be timestamped before first pitch
R0.sensitivity: also scored at the archived marketImpliedProbability as entry price

R0b_supplementary.definition: every intraday ledger row with status Accepted (pre_game_decision snapshots + final pipeline ledger), first pre-first-pitch occurrence per (ticker, side), same quote rule as R0

R3_vs_R0: R0 bets (at R0 quote, archived model prob) failing R3's criteria (net edge >= 0.05 and |model-mid| <= 0.10) are 'avoided by R3'; report outcomes of avoided vs kept
diagnostics: all quoted contracts with a point-in-time model value, per family and per model source: Brier and log loss (model vs mid), calibration slope logit(y)~logit(p) for model and mid, joint logistic y ~ logit(model) + logit(mid)
evaluator: local copy of /home/user/sift-alpha-ops/alpha_engine/pipeline/selection.py (sift-selection/1), fee_order reimplemented identically to sift_clv.canonical.estimate_fee
families_other_block_rule: winning_margin (not in the requested list) and any prop family with >= 300 EXPLORE contracts across >= 50 games (coverage-only criterion) are scored in a separate block with the same rules

fees.depth: no displayed sizes exist; all P&L assumes fills at top-of-book with unknown depth

frozen_at_utc: 2026-11-20 (before any outcome-dependent number was computed; build stage reads no settlement data)
outcome_exposure_before_freeze: Only file FORMATS of settlement sources were inspected (one record each); no outcome was joined to any model or quote.

point_in_time.close_quote: latest two-sided quote strictly before first pitch; used for CLV only if observed strictly after the entry quote, else CLV is missing (not zero)
point_in_time.entry_quote: latest two-sided uncrossed quote (0<bid<ask<1) with capturedAt <= first_pitch - 10 min, excluding rows flagged gameStartedAtCapture or checkpoint POST_START
point_in_time.excluded: RL_Home/RL_Away ledger rows (side orientation on the shared KXMLBSPREAD ticker not recorded); F3/F7 series (not a family of interest)
point_in_time.first_pitch: earliest of: repo games file scheduledStartTime (data/edgelab/games, canonical via supersededBy), observation scheduledStart, Kalshi event-ticker ET time

model_timestamps.discovery_adapter: data/kalshi/discovery/<date>.json generatedAt (NOT the extension rows' provenance.capturedAt, which is a quote time)

point_in_time.model_value: latest model P(YES) with timestamp <= entry quote time (and < first pitch); ties prefer the pipeline ledger over the discovery adapter

reliability_map.candidate: EXPLORE n >= 60 AND observed win rate - mean break-even >= 0.04 AND |mean model prob - observed win rate| <= 0.05
reliability_map.cells: family x entry bucket x side
reliability_map.confirm: each candidate scored once on CONFIRM (all CONFIRM sides in that cell)
reliability_map.population: every quoted contract side (YES at ask, NO at 1-bid) in families_in_rules with entry in [0.05,0.95]
reliability_map.survival: CONFIRM n >= 30 AND net ROI > 0 AND win rate >= mean break-even -> label 'survived one forward split - not validated'; the game-bootstrap ROI CI is reported alongside

rule_semantics: net edge = model prob (side) - entry (YES at yes_ask, NO at 1-yes_bid) - 0.07P(1-P); disagreement = |model(side) - mid(side)|; one bet per game x family with the largest net edge (selection.py)

settlement.truth: Kalshi official result (sift-data-vault archives/MLB/kalshi_official_settlements/all-to-20261116), yes->1 no->0; non-binary dropped

split.rule: EXPLORE = game ET date < 2026-09-15; CONFIRM = >= 2026-09-15 (incl. postseason)

summary_stats: bets, games, wins, win rate (Wilson 95%), avg entry, avg fee, break-even (entry+fee), expected win rate (mean model prob), net P&L, ROI with game-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples, seed 7), selection CLV = close_mid - entry_mid (fee reported separately, never as CLV); by family, side and entry bucket [0.05,0.25),[0.25,0.5),[0.5,0.75),[0.75,0.95]
title: MLB operating-model reliability: when is SIFT right? (RESEARCH_ONLY)
